Reel 01 · Grainy, Half-Remembered

Where It All Began

2024 – 2025

Every journey has a starting point, and this is ours.

Back in 2024, we would occasionally see each other in a YouTube live chat. Our conversations were nothing more than simple "hello" and "hi" messages. At the time, they felt ordinary, and neither of us knew those small interactions would eventually lead us here.

Everything changed in December 2024.

At 9:16 PM, during a YouTube membership gifting event, I noticed that you weren't able to receive a gifted membership. I thought it might be because you were using an iPhone, so I decided to message you and help. It was a small conversation with a simple intention, but it became the moment that started our journey.

A month later, on 19 January 2025, we had our first proper conversation. We talked about how things were going, what was happening around us, and mostly about roleplay scenarios and the server. There was nothing extraordinary about those conversations, but they were honest, comfortable, and effortless.

As days turned into weeks, we continued talking. Message by message, we got to know each other a little better. Without realizing it, a genuine friendship was beginning to grow.

Looking back now, it's amazing how one small message, sent with the intention of helping someone, became the first chapter of a story that means so much to both of us.

This stage is deliberately black-and-white and a little grainy — memory before it had color.

Reel 03 · Autumn, Golden

Growing Friendship, Growing Closer

Mid 2025

Looking back, it is amazing how everything started so simply. It began with daily good mornings, random pins, asking about each other's day, and endless conversations about RP. Slowly, those chats turned into conversations about our lives. We talked about your friend leaving for a new city, my college, my results, new opportunities, and all the little things happening around us. Before we even realized it, we had become a part of each other's everyday lives.

There is one conversation I will never forget, even though I cannot remember the exact date. I remember telling you that you made me calmer and more grounded. I even joked that my ability to deal with dumb people had increased because of you. It made us laugh, but there was a lot of truth behind those words. Somehow, your presence always made everything feel lighter.

One of my favorite memories is 25 May 2025, the day I saved your contact name as "Panda." When I told you, you immediately protested and asked why I would call you Panda. I still smile whenever I think about that conversation because, even though you never agreed with the nickname, it had already become special to me.

As our friendship grew, so did our trust. I shared the story of my very first situationship with you, and you listened without judging me. You were patient, understanding, and always there whenever I needed someone to talk to. That was when I realized how lucky I was to have a friend like you.

By the time November and December came around, our daily messages had become a beautiful routine. We had already exchanged 63 good mornings and 76 good nights. They were never just greetings. They were little reminders that, no matter how busy life became, we would always make time for each other.

Looking back now, I realize our friendship was never built by one big moment. It was built through every random message, every laugh, every conversation, every good morning, and every good night. Without either of us noticing, those little moments slowly brought us closer and became the beginning of something truly beautiful.

Notice the palette warming and the season turning — this is the part where a stranger starts becoming someone.

Reel 04 · Bright, Loud, Silly

Game Nights and Movie Nights

Some of my favorite memories with you were made during our movie nights and game nights. On 25 June 2025, we started playing Uno together. At first, it was just another game, but it quickly became one of our favorite ways to spend time together. It was never about winning or losing. It was about laughing, teasing each other, and making every game memorable.

Then, on 27 December 2025, we started watching movies together. What began as watching a movie or an episode here and there soon became our little tradition. We would always tell ourselves, "Just one more," and somehow one more always turned into another.

Between the games and the movies, we shared everything with each other. We talked about our days, laughed over the smallest things, and simply enjoyed being together. Those moments became the highlight of my days, giving us a space where we could just be ourselves.

Looking back now, I realize it was during those Uno matches and movie nights that we truly came closer. They were never just games or movies. They became our comfort, our happiest memories, and the moments that quietly strengthened our bond.

Reel 05 · Spring Garden, In Bloom

Falling for You

One month in

Before I even realized what I was feeling, there were already little signs.

The first time I saw you was on 28 April 2025. I still remember how beautiful you looked in that saree. I admired you, but I never really thought about why.

Then came 24 February 2026, the second time I saw you. That day felt different. The moment I saw you, my heart started beating faster. It was a feeling I had never experienced before. Since then, every time I see you or even look at your photos, my heart still skips a beat. Back then, I did not understand what that feeling meant. Now, I know exactly what it was.

From our movie nights that began on 23 December 2025 to our countless conversations afterward, everything slowly started changing. We shared our thoughts, our opinions, and our everyday lives. Every conversation brought us a little closer.

Somewhere along the way, you became the one person I could tell everything. My family problems, office stress, college, studies, my startup ideas, my company, my tuitions, RP, and every little thing happening in my life. There was never a moment when I felt judged. You always listened with patience, understood me, and became the strongest support system I could have ever asked for.

As time passed, I found myself growing more attached to you. My feelings became stronger with every conversation, every movie night, every Uno game, and every moment we spent together. I tried convincing myself not to fall for you. I reminded myself that we had our little differences and told myself that maybe I should not let my heart get carried away.

But the heart has its own way of making decisions.

No matter how much I tried to ignore it, I could no longer deny the truth. Somewhere between our conversations, our laughter, our games, and our countless memories, I had fallen for you.

And today, without a single doubt, I know that you are the love of my life.

Whenever I close my eyes, I see these two photos. You are a gift to me from God, and I will cherish you for my whole life.

Picture a garden bursting with color, every kind of flower blooming and falling at once. This is the stage where things stopped being quiet and started being unmistakable.

Reel 06 · Just Us

Forever Choosing You

Today

There was a time when I kept telling myself not to fall for you. I thought about our little differences and wondered if this was the right path. But every conversation, every laugh, every game night, every movie night, every good morning, and every good night slowly gave me the answer I was looking for.

Then came the day we chose each other.

Last month, we decided to commit to this beautiful journey. It was never just about becoming a couple. It was about promising to stand beside each other through everything life brings.

In just one month, we have already spent 97.3 hours on voice calls. That is not just time on a screen. Those hours are filled with laughter, random conversations, silence that never felt awkward, endless stories, and countless memories. Every minute has made me feel even more certain that choosing you was the best decision I have ever made.

People say the beginning of a relationship is just the honeymoon phase. Maybe they are right. Life will test us. There will be misunderstandings, difficult days, and moments that challenge us. But if there is one promise I want to make, it is this:

I will always choose you.

Not just on the easy days, but on the difficult ones too. Love is not about choosing someone once. It is about choosing the same person, every single day.

When I say, "I love you more," I do not mean I love you more than you love me. I mean I will love you more than every bad day, every distance, every misunderstanding, and every obstacle that comes our way.

You never have to be perfect for me because every imperfection you see in yourself is a part of the person I fell in love with. To me, you are already perfect. Your smile is my peace. Your voice is my comfort. Your presence feels like home.

So today, on our one-month anniversary, I want to make one final promise.

No matter what happens, I will keep choosing you, over and over again.

Because you are not just the love of my life.

You are my home, my peace, my Panda, and the best decision I have ever made.

Happy One Month Anniversary, my love. Here's to forever. ❤️

I love you, baby.

Every reel, every rewind, every "hello" that turned into today. It all led here, to you. However this month started, I already know I want a hundred more just like it.

Happy one month. I love you, baby.
